agent_priors_used: Agent prior (NOT SPIDER evidence): autonomous research systems exhibit path dependence/local-attractor behavior; heavy concentration on one claim is a diagnostic that mandates an explicit cognitive reset but does not mechanically force a pivot.

Agent prior (NOT SPIDER evidence): repeatedly repairing the same predicate/instrument on the same gate has decaying marginal value; after bounded control-plane defects the correct move is to repair the shared prerequisite/certifiability machinery once (here design-contract v2's six freeze-eligibility checks plus independent design_review).

Agent prior (NOT SPIDER evidence): a treatment cannot demonstrate value against a comparator already at ceiling; pre-freeze dynamic-range certification is a first-class prerequisite, not a post-hoc discovery.

Agent prior (NOT SPIDER evidence): expensive end-to-end multi-arm benchmarks should be funded only after their prerequisites (shipped treatment carrier, non-degenerate task bank, capable same-model endpoint) are removed; otherwise the run is non-identifying.

Agent prior (NOT SPIDER evidence): already-frozen transactions should be allowed to complete before strategic redirection, and a design that can fail its freeze-eligibility gate cheaply is preferable to an expensive invalid EXECUTE.

Agent prior (NOT SPIDER evidence): a falsifier that is arithmetically checkable and satisfiable in BOTH directions, with an attainability certificate, materially reduces empty-accept-region and unsatisfiable-predicate failures.

allocation.comparative_reasoning: Compared with (a) the inherited handoff's four-arm C-LLM-INHERIT benchmark - explicitly deferred: the Director rule forbids funding that execution until all three readiness conditions hold, and conditions (2) and (3) are still open, so the run would be non-identifying; (b) PIVOT to C-RESIDUAL-NOVELTY economics - blocked on the same task-bank dynamic-range gap Runtime is repairing; (c) PIVOT to C-FRESHNESS/freshness policy - lower leverage and owned by Graph, and the carrier is the prerequisite for any drift/refresh story actually mattering. Landing the carrier is the single change that most increases the value of all other lanes' work.

allocation.question: Can the audited parameterized-inheritance capability be landed as a durable, promotable mechanism on the SHIPPED kernel path - with a pre-freeze arm-differentiation certificate (a known-positive executable inherited-parameterized-mechanism round trip plus a known-negative refusal with a recorded reason and a null action), tests, per-arm accounting, and kernel identity bound at freeze - so that it lands through the pinned promotion path rather than as an experimental module?
allocation.rationale: This is readiness condition (1) and Audit priority 1 (B1, highest leverage). The parameterized path is demonstrably live and causally attributable on a real credential-free substrate (EXP-PRODUCT-37973256064, audit PASS), but main still exposes only literal distill() with confidence 0.5 and no shipped distill_parameterized(). Without the carrier on the shipped path, every downstream benchmark would test an experimental module rather than the product, and the decisive causal chain cannot be closed. The active pre-freeze experiment is exactly the promotion-carrier task, already framed to supersede the premature four-arm benchmark.

director_mandate.portfolio_assessment: All six lanes carry a live transaction: five are PREFREEZE (graph, runtime, product, intel, frontier) and one is FROZEN (physics). The program's decisive missing proof remains one causal chain: a SHIPPED parameterized mechanism -> an applicability/freshness decision -> a real external-agent action -> lower end-to-end cost per successful partially novel Web task after retrieval, verification and repair. The Audit (2026-10-10) reduces that to three readiness conditions, and each is already targeted by an existing pre-freeze experiment: Product -> land the audited parameterized carrier with a known-positive/known-negative arm-differentiation certificate (readiness 1); Runtime -> certify a non-degenerate asymmetric-discovery task bank with honest counters (readiness 2); Intel -> settle whether a capable same-model endpoint exists or explicitly close/re-scope the credential-free path (readiness 3). Those are Audit priorities 1-3 and they must continue rather than be re-litigated. Physics holds a FROZEN barrier-onset/recovery experiment (a genuinely new observable, not another value-persistence estimator) that must complete under its frozen design. Graph's active D1V-constructibility gate is the decisive feasibility step for the freshness route (Audit priority 6) and is a bounded decision experiment. Frontier's site-native discovery question is still entirely UNMEASURED - v1 died on an empty sampling frame - and can invalidate the path-persistence premise outright. The dominant program risk is not activity but repeated prerequisite/prerequisite-certificate failure; that cost belongs in the shared design-contract v2 eligibility gate before freeze, not in another MEASUREMENT_INVALID EXECUTE. On merits, every currently active direction still beats its plausible alternatives, so all six lanes CONTINUE; no lane is parked or terminated this cycle.
director_mandate.scout_assessment: The Scout ran in DEGRADED SCOUT MODE (recorded model failure: opencode/big-pickle exit 143, rc=124; external_directional_context and spider_evidence are empty arrays). Its candidate_directions are therefore restatements of the active mandates rather than independent reconnaissance, and I did not treat them as authority. Its only independently useful contribution was the liveness map (graph/runtime/product/intel/frontier PREFREEZE; physics not listed as idle), which I confirmed against the machine snapshot. No external finding altered any allocation; the brief neither added nor removed a candidate on evidentiary grounds, and I performed no separate browsing because the brief offered nothing strategically uncertain that warranted deep verification.
